integrity: All stated infinite assertions have combinatorial proofs; finite exact enumeration is corroboration only. Historical priority and independent audit are not certified.
scientific_limitations: The exact bounded correction is explicit for the three-vertex part, not for all fixed part sizes.
The independent binomial extraction requires the other part size at least twice the small-side size minus two.
Only uniform independent labelled spanning trees of complete bipartite graphs are covered.
title: Exact finite common-edge laws for pairs of spanning trees in complete bipartite graphs
